hotspots.title: November 2005
hotspots.body: The fourth film arrived in mid-November 2005, directed by Mike Newell, the first British director of the series.

hotspots.title: A step darker
hotspots.body: It was the first film in the series to be rated PG-13 in the United States, reflecting the tournament's danger and the darkness of its ending.

hotspots.title: A maze that closes behind you
hotspots.body: The final task is a hedge maze that seems alive: paths seal over, mist rolls between the walls, and the competitors turn on each other as the hedges press in.

hotspots.title: Walls on the move
hotspots.body: The maze combined tall physical hedge walls on the stage, some built to move and close in on the actors, with digital extensions for its full size.

hotspots.title: Weeks underwater
hotspots.body: For the lake task, Daniel Radcliffe trained to dive and filmed in a large tank at the studio, holding his breath between takes while safety divers waited just out of shot.

hotspots.title: The black lake
hotspots.body: The second task sends champions to the bottom of the lake to recover something precious. The film makes the water murky and full of reaching shapes.

hotspots.title: A new composer
hotspots.body: Patrick Doyle wrote the score, introducing a stately waltz for the winter ball alongside the familiar main theme.

hotspots.title: The face of the villain
hotspots.body: Ralph Fiennes appeared as the dark wizard for the first time, fully embodied after three films of shadows, flashbacks and borrowed faces.

hotspots.title: Fire in the dark
hotspots.body: The first task pits each champion against a dragon. The film's chase across the castle roofs was invented for the screen.

hotspots.title: A champion's face
hotspots.body: Robert Pattinson played the well-liked Hufflepuff champion, a role that came a few years before his own rise to fame.

hotspots.title: One nomination
hotspots.body: The film received an Academy Award nomination for art direction, recognising Stuart Craig and Stephenie McMillan's work on the tournament's sets.

collectibles.name: A golden egg
collectibles.note: It shrieks when opened. Try it underwater.

collectibles.name: A dance card
collectibles.note: Half filled in, in nervous handwriting.
